incompleteness_to_hypothesis_conversion.description: Mappings for converting irreducible or asymptotic incompleteness into formal theorem hypotheses.

conversions.statement: The theorem holds for any non-invertible transport operator satisfying local CSI conservation.
Continuity stability holds for all admissible branches in a non-unique continuation set.
Assumes that resonance-induced drift at the asymptotic limit is bounded by finite-scale dissipation invariants.
